description: The Uttar Pradesh government is preparing to use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to make the implementation of welfare schemes faster, more transparent and better monitored.
body_lead: The Uttar Pradesh government is preparing to use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to make the implementation of welfare schemes faster, more transparent and better monitored. The proposed system will use technology across processes such as document verification, beneficiary monitoring and fund transfers. The initiative is aimed at reducing fraudulent claims and unnecessary delays while ensuring that eligible beneficiaries receive government support on time. AI to Strengthen Document Verification Under the proposed AI-based system, documents and beneficiary information will be checked digitally.
